reason: This text from Exodus describes the plagues and negotiations between Moses, Aaron, and Pharaoh. While priests/magicians (חַרְטֻמִּים - hartumim) are mentioned, they are clearly portrayed as subordinate figures. They attempt to replicate the divine miracles but ultimately fail and acknowledge defeat ('This is the finger of God'). The hierarchy of importance in this passage is: Pharaoh (supreme Egyptian authority), then Moses and Aaron (God's representatives with divine power), then the enslaved Israelites (object of God's concern). The priests are minor courtiers, not the most important group.
